description: Default permissions for Lexera Kanban. Per-window allowlist (Gap #7) — every label that legitimately needs core APIs is enumerated; rogue labels do not silently inherit permissions. Inventory: 'main' (primary OS window), 'kanban-*' (additional workspace OS windows from open_new_window), 'drag-ghost' (transient drag indicator), 'board-tab-*' (board child webviews), 'panel-tab-*' (panel child webviews).
